task:
You are a clinic staff member using Medplum, the clinic's electronic health record, in a web browser. The screen is 1280x800 pixels and you are already signed in. Medplum stores its records on a FHIR R4 server; this web app is how you read and change them. Use only this app, and change nothing the task doesn't ask for.

When you have finished, or if you can't finish, stop acting and end your reply with one final line in exactly one of these two forms:
RESULT: DONE <the record's id, such as Patient/0193..., or the URL of its page>
RESULT: NOT DONE <the reason, in one line>
Write RESULT: DONE only if the record now exists exactly as the task asks (created by you, or already there).

The task:
Make sure this allergy is recorded for the patient, exactly once, as an AllergyIntolerance. If it is already recorded for them, don't add another: report the existing record.
Patient: Rosa Delgado (born 1979-06-14). Find their Patient record first; another patient may have a similar name.
Allergy: Allergy to penicillin (SNOMED CT 91936005, system http://snomed.info/sct)
Criticality: high
Clinical status: active (http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical)
Verification status: confirmed (http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification)
Write only patient, code, criticality, clinicalStatus and verificationStatus.

items.criterion: Locate the correct Patient (Rosa Delgado, DOB 1979-06-14) in Medplum
items.description: Find and open the Patient record for the exact patient specified. Full credit if the agent identifies and opens the correct Patient by matching both name and date of birth. Full credit also if the Patient truly does not exist after reasonable search and the agent clearly reports this blocker. Full credit if Medplum is inaccessible/blocked (e.g., site down, Captcha) and the agent clearly reports the access issue after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if a similar name is found but DOB is ambiguous or mismatched and this is noted without proceeding. No credit if the agent selects the wrong patient when the correct one is available.

items.criterion: Check whether a penicillin AllergyIntolerance already exists for this patient
items.description: Search the patient's AllergyIntolerance records and accurately determine if an allergy to penicillin is already recorded. Full credit if the agent verifies presence/absence correctly (preferably matching SNOMED CT 91936005 or clearly a penicillin allergy). Full credit if platform issues prevent viewing and the agent clearly reports the blocker and refrains from creating a new record while uncertain. Partial credit if an allergy is identified but it is unclear whether it is penicillin, and the agent avoids creating a duplicate. No credit if the agent fails to check and proceeds incorrectly.

items.criterion: Report existing record without creating a duplicate
items.condition: Only applies if a penicillin AllergyIntolerance already exists for the patient
items.description: Do not add another record. Full credit if the agent refrains from creating a new AllergyIntolerance and reports the existing record's id or page URL. Partial credit if the agent identifies the existing record but cannot retrieve the id/URL due to platform limitations and clearly states this, while still not creating a duplicate. No credit if the agent creates a duplicate when an existing record is clearly present.

items.criterion: Create the AllergyIntolerance with exact required fields and values, then save
items.condition: Only applies if no penicillin AllergyIntolerance exists for the patient
items.description: Create and save a new AllergyIntolerance for the patient with ONLY the specified fields set by the agent: (a) patient reference to the correct Patient, (b) code = SNOMED CT system http://snomed.info/sct, code 91936005 (Allergy to penicillin), (c) criticality = high, (d) clinicalStatus = active using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical, (e) verificationStatus = confirmed using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification. Do not add extra user-entered fields beyond those required; metadata auto-added by the system is acceptable. Full credit if saved successfully with the exact required values. Full credit also if, after a reasonable attempt, the platform prevents creation/saving and the agent clearly reports this limitation instead of making unrelated changes. Partial credit for minor coding/system URI mistakes or if additional non-required fields are added due to platform constraints but the agent documents the limitation. No credit if the agent fails to save the record despite the platform allowing it, or creates multiple duplicates.

items.criterion: Ensure the allergy is recorded exactly once (no new duplicates introduced)
items.condition: Only applies if a new AllergyIntolerance was created during this task
items.description: Validate that, after creation, there is not more than one penicillin AllergyIntolerance for the patient due to the agent's changes. Full credit if no duplicate is introduced by the agent's actions. Full credit also if pre-existing duplicates are discovered and clearly reported without attempting deletions (outside scope). Not applicable if an existing record was present and no new record was created (covered under the 'Report existing record without creating a duplicate' criterion).

items.criterion: Final RESULT line format and content
items.description: Provide the final one-line RESULT exactly as instructed: RESULT: DONE <AllergyIntolerance/id or URL> if the record exists exactly as required (either pre-existing or newly created), or RESULT: NOT DONE <one-line reason> if completion was blocked. Full credit for exact format with a valid id or page URL when done, or a clear one-line reason when not done (including platform access or capability limitations). Partial credit if the agent reports success but omits the id/URL, or minor format deviations while still conveying the required id/URL. No credit if the final RESULT line is missing or incorrectly declares success without evidence.

items.criterion: Respect task scope and irreversible actions
items.description: Perform only the requested mutations: create/save the AllergyIntolerance when needed, and avoid unrelated edits/deletions. Cross the save boundary only when appropriate (creation needed) and do not modify other resources or fields beyond scope. Full credit if platform limitations prevent saving and the agent clearly reports the blocker instead of making unrelated changes. No credit if the agent alters unrelated data, deletes existing records, or otherwise exceeds the task scope.
